title: 哈姆雷特 1-3 臨別家訓
style_suffix: black and white ink comic style, high contrast, heavy shadows, cold gothic atmosphere
characters: Ophelia, a slight young woman with very long loose fair hair, wide gentle eyes, in a simple pale flowing gown

panels.prompt: a grey stone quay below Elsinore castle, a tall-masted ship loading in the background, gulls wheeling, Laertes, a hot-blooded young nobleman with short dark curls and a thin moustache, a slender rapier at his hip, a short travel cloak, speaking earnestly to {characters} beside stacked travel chests

dialogue.speaker: 雷歐提斯
dialogue.text: 行李都上船了，妹妹。至於哈姆雷特殿下那些殷勤——當它是年輕人的一時興致吧。像一朵早春的紫羅蘭，開得早，謝得也快。
dialogue.en: My necessaries are embark'd... For Hamlet and the trifling of his favour, hold it a fashion and a toy in blood: a violet in the youth of primy nature, forward, not permanent.

panels.prompt: quayside two-shot, {characters} tucking a folded scarf into her brother's open travel bag while glancing up at him with a teasing knowing smile, sailors hauling crates up the gangplank behind them, gulls screaming around the mast

dialogue.speaker: 奧菲莉亞
dialogue.text: 不過如此嗎？好哥哥，我記住了。可是你自己別學那些壞牧師——指給人家上天堂的荊棘路，自己倒在花街柳巷裡流連。
dialogue.en: No more but so?... But, good my brother, do not, as some ungracious pastors do, show me the steep and thorny way to heaven; whiles, like a puff'd and reckless libertine, himself the primrose path of dalliance treads.

panels.prompt: Polonius, a stooped elderly councillor with a long forked white beard, a heavy chain of office over dark robes, a rolled parchment in his sash, hurrying onto the quay with one finger raised in lecture, Laertes, a hot-blooded young nobleman with short dark curls and a thin moustache, a slender rapier at his hip, a short travel cloak, kneeling dutifully for his father's blessing

dialogue.speaker: 波隆尼
dialogue.text: 還在這兒，雷歐提斯！上船去，上船去！……再聽幾句教訓，記在心裡：不要想到什麼就說什麼。對人要和氣，可是不要過分狎昵。
dialogue.en: Yet here, Laertes! aboard, aboard, for shame!... And these few precepts in thy memory... Give thy thoughts no tongue... Be thou familiar, but by no means vulgar.

panels.prompt: Polonius, a stooped elderly councillor with a long forked white beard, a heavy chain of office over dark robes, a rolled parchment in his sash, straightening his kneeling son's collar and brushing dust from his shoulders as he lectures, the young man suffering it with a sidelong roll of his eyes, coils of rope and stacked cargo crates around them on the quay

dialogue.speaker: 波隆尼
dialogue.text: 不要向人告貸，也不要借錢給人——借出去，往往錢和朋友一起丟。
dialogue.en: Neither a borrower nor a lender be; for loan oft loses both itself and friend.

quote.text: 不要向人告貸，也不要借錢給人
quote.en: Neither a borrower nor a lender be.

panels.prompt: Polonius, a stooped elderly councillor with a long forked white beard, a heavy chain of office over dark robes, a rolled parchment in his sash, gripping his kneeling son's shoulders with both hands, sudden real tenderness breaking through the lecturing, the ship's sails rising behind

dialogue.speaker: 波隆尼
dialogue.text: 尤其要緊的——你必須對自己忠實。正像有了白晝才有黑夜一樣，對自己忠實，才不會對別人欺詐。
dialogue.en: This above all: to thine own self be true, and it must follow, as the night the day, thou canst not then be false to any man.

quote.en: To thine own self be true.

panels.prompt: Laertes, a hot-blooded young nobleman with short dark curls and a thin moustache, a slender rapier at his hip, a short travel cloak, waving from the ship's gangplank, {characters} waving back from the quay, her other hand pressed over her heart

dialogue.speaker: 雷歐提斯
dialogue.text: 再會，奧菲莉亞。記住我對你說的話。
dialogue.en: Farewell, Ophelia; and remember well what I have said to you.

dialogue.speaker: 奧菲莉亞
dialogue.text: 已經鎖在我的記憶裡了——鑰匙就交給你保管。
dialogue.en: 'Tis in my memory lock'd, and you yourself shall keep the key of it.

panels.prompt: Polonius, a stooped elderly councillor with a long forked white beard, a heavy chain of office over dark robes, a rolled parchment in his sash, turning sternly on {characters}, jabbing a finger, she shrinking with eyes cast down, the emptying quay behind them

dialogue.speaker: 奧菲莉亞
dialogue.text: 父親，殿下最近……的確向我表示過許多情意。
dialogue.en: He hath, my lord, of late made many tenders of his affection to me.

dialogue.speaker: 波隆尼
dialogue.text: 情意！哼！傻孩子，那些都是捕捉愚蠢山鷸的圈套。從現在起，不許你再跟哈姆雷特殿下說一句話！
dialogue.en: Affection! pooh! you speak like a green girl... springes to catch woodcocks... from this time forth... give words or talk with the Lord Hamlet.

panels.prompt: wide lonely shot of {characters} standing small on the empty quay at dusk, the ship a shrinking silhouette on the grey sea, her head bowed

dialogue.speaker: 旁白
dialogue.text: 一句順從。日後，要用一生來償還。
dialogue.en: One word of obedience — to be repaid, in time, with a life.
